subtitle: Academic Drawing
teachers:
KATAGIRI Yukiko
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) gain basic skill in graphical communication for field survey and site analysis for environmental design.
(2) gain basic skills in graphical comunication for environmental design proposals.
advice:
This is a basic course on graphical communication for environmental design. We will cover the following step:
1. FIeld survey
2. Site analysis
3. Conceptual diagraming
4. Design proposal

These skills are useful in all subjects, particular in  “PDII" ,“Design Project / Implementing and Operating" and "Project Design III”.　

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring drawing materials and other necessary materials to every class.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course on graphical communication for environmental design. We will cover the following step:
1. FIeld survey
2. Site analysis
3. Conceptual diagraming
4. Design proposal

These skills are useful in all subjects, particular in  “PDII" ,“Design Project / Implementing and Operating" and "Project Design III”.　

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring drawing materials and other necessary materials to every class.
